```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
snap_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snap_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  page <- request(url) |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 5) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  tbl <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table()
  attr_vals <- page |>
    html_elements("td strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  tbl |>
    select(rank_title_year = `Rank & Title`, rating = `IMDb Rating`) |>
    mutate(
      rank_title_year = str_replace_all(rank_title_year, "\n +", " "),
      number = str_extract(attr_vals, "(?<=based on )[0-9,]+") |>
        parse_number()
    ) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title_year,
      patterns = c(rank = "\\d+", "\\. ", title = ".+", " +\\(", year = "\\d+", "\\)")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      rank = as.integer(rank),
      year = as.integer(year),
      snap_year = snap_year
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snap_urls, snap_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
imdb_rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  mutate(release_decade = year %/% 10 * 10) |>
  select(title, release_decade, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(rank_change = abs(rank_2022 - rank_2015))

imdb_rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

imdb_rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, snap_year) |>
  count(title, name = "snapshot_count") |>
  count(snapshot_count, name = "film_count") |>
  arrange(snapshot_count)
```

```{r}
rank_change_by_decade <- imdb_rank_changes |>
  mutate(signed_rank_change = rank_2015 - rank_2022) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(signed_rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade) |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(avg_rank_change > 0, "Rose", "Fell"),
    release_decade = factor(
      paste0(release_decade, "s"),
      levels = paste0(release_decade, "s")
    )
  )

ggplot(rank_change_by_decade, aes(x = avg_rank_change, y = release_decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Rank direction",
    values = c("Rose" = "#2c7fb8", "Fell" = "#f03b20")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IMDb Rankings Shifted by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Average rank improvement from 2015 to 2022; positive values indicate a rise",
    x = "Average rank improvement (2015 rank - 2022 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = "Sample: 190 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
